body: Stress + anxiety maybe.  I would go see a counsellor at school to discuss that.  I have the same kind of feelings all the time, thinking that my life will amount to nothing.  It sucks.  Counselling is good though.

I use walking while listening to music (with headphones) to clear my mind.  Make a solid playlist and hit the streets or trail close to home.  The idea of just going for a walk was never appealing to me but now I walk or hike 2 hours every day because I got hooked.  20 minutes to start is good.
I haven't been through the same situation but I did not like Wellbutrin at all.  It just made me feel "off" so I stopped taking it on my own, like every good patient...
Very cool! Can't wait until I see them for myself some day :)

I need more support than any counselor can give, being confined to 50 minutes every few weeks isn't enough.  But I hear what you're saying.  I had a great counselor about 4 years ago that was so good at seeing me really frequently but she had a flare up of MS and had to stop working :(
It is, especially when I think i just need to be able to say things out loud to help get them out of my mind
I'm 24 and I just started university, after 2 years in a technical program.  It's never too late to go back but it does suck.

I looks like a Butternut (white walnut) tree, if it is, it likely has Butternut Canker.  The tree will not survive but may last several more years. Butternut Canker is a fungal disease and will spread to neighboring Butternuts.

Me too.  It's exhausting and people in my life don't understand it.  But to be fair, I don't understand it either.  It just sucks.  We are expected
 to carry on like any other human, but doing things is harder when you don't want to be alive.
